purpose: Build and smoke-test a local open-source MD creation, trajectory display, and geometric analysis app. A short OpenMM ubiquitin demo demonstrates integration only; no equilibrium, affinity, stability, mechanistic, or comparative engine claims are proposed.

scope.intended_compute: Short single-replica real protein trajectory plus deterministic software fixtures
scope.review_identity: Language-model code/evidence review; PatAgent is an automated checklist inspired by public writings, not Pat Walters or domain-expert validation.

pending: Record engine/library versions, actual preparation, seeds, input/output checksums, configuration, logs, runtime, platform and exclusions for any run.

scientific_review_plan: Check Angstrom/nanometer and ps/fs conversions at every API boundary.
Check trajectory/topology ordering, zero-based atom picks, caps, finite coordinates, time metadata, trajectory mismatches.
Use raw saved coordinates for geometric measurements, periodic minimum-image geometry when box metadata are valid.
Keep display interpolation separate from physical measurements; prevent interpolation across periodic wraps.
Document hydrogen bond as D-A <= 3.5 Angstrom and D-H-A >= 150 degrees, explicit bonded hydrogen and donor/acceptor element screening; occupancy is geometric only.
Report fixed engine force fields, solvent method, constraints, thermostat, integration step and initialization; do not silently remove unsupported ligands.
Document short-demo absence of convergence and independent replicas.

validation.status: preflight; code and executable run artifacts pending

comparison.notes: No scientific engine-performance comparison or statistical inference proposed.
